title: The extension you never installed: KREMLIN forges Chrome's own integrity checks to steal banking sessions
content: Brazilian banking malware operation REF9334 has been deploying KREMLIN toolkit since May 2025, targeting Brazilian financial institutions through malicious browser extensions. The operation uses multi-stage JavaScript loaders, custom C++ installers, and exploits Chromium integrity mechanisms by manipulating Secure Preferences and regenerating required HMACs. Associated malware: Virus:DOS/Kremlin, Trojan:Win32/DoublePulsar, Remcos - S0332.

title: The banana stand: brokering and managing infections across Asia using MQTT
content: BambooToken is an emerging multiplatform malware family active since at least February 2023, utilizing the Message Queueing and Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol for covert command and control operations. The campaign targets Windows and Linux systems across Asia and South America, with infections observed on backend servers for mobile applications, legal and financial services, software... This pulse includes 47 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance, Government, Technology. Associated malware: BambooToken, IOCONTROL, PlugX - S0013.

title: Fake MP4 File Carries Malicious Payload
content: A sophisticated infection chain leverages PowerShell loaders to deliver encrypted NetSupport client payloads concealed within fake MP4 files. The malicious MP4 containers appear valid to basic file-type checks but contain 6.5 MB of encrypted data in ISO Base Media File Format uuid extension boxes rather than playable video content. title: skynox7: Proxyjacking Edge Devices Into Residential Proxies
content: A malicious cyber actor conducted a proxyjacking campaign, compromising at least 143 network edge devices across 34 countries to force them into residential proxy networks. The attacker exploited vulnerabilities in D-Link ShareCenter NAS devices, Ubiquiti UniFi Video NVR systems, and SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer, also targeting DVR/NVR devices from Hikvision and Dahua.
